Text: Most X research dies in a browser tab.

I built xint so one query becomes a filtered search, live monitor, local dataset, report, or MCP tool for an agent.

It uses the official X API. Credentials, cache, snapshots, and reports stay local by default.

Open source. MIT. https://t.co/9XG5rwxAcL
